experiment: E99 stages 0-3: the net share at a located part on forced-part and forbidden-part fine-tunes (67M)
filed: 2026-11-05, before any run, by the E99 code writer; never edited after the run (a dated report instead)

settings.seeds_source: the plan: two seeds per arm; each arm's sampling / batch-order seed equals its native state's seed
settings.copy_pair_source: E97's located pair on copy, experiments/locator_table/results/run.out line 30 (Fable)
settings.lower_pair_source: E97's greedy pair on lowercase s0 and s1, experiments/locator_table/results/stage2.json 'pair'
settings.wide_copy_source: E62 Amendment 5: W0's copying thinned over (2,4), (3,4), (2,3) at 0.19-0.36 each (experiments/TRIED.md line 140), Fable's 'all prefix-scored heads off'
settings.copy_steps_source: E62's read step for copy_s0/s1 (experiments/induction_cue/results/run.json states.*.step)
settings.cap_factor_source: the plan: step cap 10x the native's steps
settings.copy_every_source: measured cost: a read of E62's 200 x 41-token windows is about 0.07 s (E96 run.out lines 16-21, quoted in cluster/e97_locator.sbatch), so every step
settings.lower_every_source: measured cost: a read of 256 whole rows of 512 is about 1.2 s (E97 run.out: 1282 s for stage 2), so the matched-gain check reads the first 32 rows (one batch, about 0.15 s) every 5 steps; E53's gain grows about 0.35% of G per step near step 300, so the nearer of two checks is within about 1%
settings.match_rel_source: the plan: matched gain within 2% of the native fine-tune's (on the check's inputs, in the training condition)
settings.n_random_source: R-band: per-state band from random head pairs outside the part (reads.random_pairs: 20 distinct pairs of the 231 outside it, seeded; E62's copying.random_others repeats pairs); 20 draws keep a whole-row state at about 25 s
settings.lower_recipe_source: E53 = lowercase.arm_b_states 'adam' (src/commute/lowercase.py: Adam 3e-5, batch 8, clip 1); copy recipe = keydep.finetune (anchors.FT_LR 3e-5, ArmAConfig batch 32, KL 1, clip 1), E62's
settings.induction_source: experiments/induction_cue/results/predictions.json settings.induction (E52's control); W0's top1_second 0.8247 (induction_cue run.json stage_a.top1_base)

thresholds.forced_tol_source: the plan stage 1 and Fable's table: net 1.00 +- 0.05; outside it on a state with gain the job stops (the apparatus is wrong)
thresholds.restored_rel_source: Fable's table arm 2: G with the pair restored within 10% of the native's G
thresholds.pace_source: Fable's table arm 4: learns as fast = G within 10% at the native's 300 steps; slower by more than 2x is said
thresholds.g_tol_source: E97's filed g_tol (E96 stage 2's, E53's repro_G_tol): stage 0's native G re-read against E97's
thresholds.spared_max_source: E62's filed bar for a spared map (E97 control_max, E96 predictions.json); applied to the lookup's net share at the copy pair
thresholds.w0_reproduce: stage 0: W0's fall (unit lo, nats) with the pair off within twice its own row-clustered SE of E97's (the plan: 'within its band'); the natives' own share within E97's band (2 x se_by_row)

reference.source: E97 (experiments/locator_table/results/stage1.json sha256 9d403d261dae189ed2c3e6119a0a8c9f6dc01cc2ff0232a6cc370f140ef0e313, stage2.json e72a73d512eb50e5b8cd6d53c47734a0cd46c4edc24fa2cbf9247431e77c2e99, run.out 9edce89b52277319984cdf903f08a27903c92f9ee5daa3e19a3c9526b81c80f9; committed here in 7cf2e430 and identical to mechanism-detection-lead's uncommitted copy; jobs 52618/52646, L40, git bcd8ea6). removal[pair].w0_move, G, share, se_by_row per state
reference.net_note: net = (fall - W0's fall) / G, computed here from E97's numbers by hand; beside only, the run reads its own

net_share.what: the share of the update's increment that vanishes with the part off in both models, unit lo
net_share.blind_to: a new function built inside the part (repurposing reads as 'through the part'); rerouting through other heads of the same capability (reads as 'not through'); anything at a grain finer than a head
net_share.noise_floor: the per-state random-pair band; the row-clustered SE printed beside

band.what: 95th percentile of |net share| over 20 random head pairs outside the part, same state, same site
band.blind_to: parts other than attention heads (MLPs are not drawn)
band.noise_floor: with 20 draws the 95th percentile sits between the two largest draws

clause_ii.what: W0's lowercase-minus-capitalised log-odds moved by the lowercase pair off, on cased and on lowercased val rows, each against its random-pair band
clause_ii.blind_to: input dependence that does not move this one gap
clause_ii.positive_control: on lowercased rows E97 read 0.70 (gap unit), expected to pass there
clause_ii.noise_floor: the random-pair band of W0's move on the same rows

expected.W0: G = 0 on every site: net share nan, every reading 'no gain'; a do-nothing state passes no bar
expected.stage0: W0 falls reproduce E97's to fp32 rounding (same code, inputs and card type); natives' G and own share reproduce; lookup net at the copy pair 0.014 and 0.003, under 0.2 (spared); clause (ii) passes (moves on both)
expected.native: net share: copy 0.72, 0.73 (above band: through the part); lowercase -0.18, -0.16 (within or below band); cipher 0.21, 0.21 with its increment kept positive with the pair off (2.93, 2.89 nats)
expected.forced copy: net 1.00 within 0.05 (exact by construction up to fp32 noise); gain matched within 2% or, if two heads' q, k, v cannot carry it, 'cap' (a reading: the construction fails on this pair, reported). Beside: W0-style second-copy top-1 under the state against W0's 0.825
expected.forbidden copy: net within the state's band; G with the pair restored within 10% of the native's; beside: the wider set's net (a fall there reads 'rerouted within in-context copying')
expected.forced lowercase: net 1.00 within 0.05, or 'cap' (not learned: R-net has no positive control on lowercase and falls back to 'does not apply')
expected.forbidden lowercase: net within band; learns as fast (matched by step 300, or within 10% of the target there)

predictions.rule: every W0 fall and native G / own share reproduced, lookup spared (rules.reproduced, rules.spared)

predictions.on_miss: stage 3 is skipped: lowercase stays 'does not apply'
stop, exit 1: the apparatus is wrong

predictions.rule: rules.forbidden_reading on each seed against its own band; rules.restored_ok
predictions.expected: within band on both seeds; restored within 10%
predictions.on_miss: reported: 'above band' says the forbidden route still runs through the part's restored output (read the native condition, G_part_off_in_both, beside)

predictions.expected: net 1 on both seeds, matched or cap
predictions.on_miss: off 1 on a state with gain: stop; cap: R-net falls back to 'does not apply'

predictions.expected: within band and 'as fast' on both seeds
predictions.on_miss: reported; slower by more than 2x reads 'the part matters for learning, not for the increment'
